units.source_text: 鹤屋就是这附近的化妆品批发商。

en.t: Tsuruya was a cosmetics wholesaler from around here.

units.source_text: 每月月中和月底，他前来讨两回账款。

en.t: Twice a month, in the middle of the month and at the end, he came to collect payments.

units.source_text: 他推光了头，剃净了络腮胡子，面孔光溜溜的泛起青色，使他显得更加胖墩墩了。

en.t: He had shaved his head smooth and cleared away his full beard, and the bluish sheen on his slick face made him look even plumper.

units.source_text: 他一醉酒，就发疯似的用筷子敲碟打碗，边敲打边吵闹，然后睡上两三个小时。

en.t: Whenever he got drunk, he would beat plates and bowls with his chopsticks like a madman, making a racket as he struck them, and then sleep for two or three hours.

units.source_text: 一睁开眼，定要攀上晒台，哪怕要付出千辛万苦也在所不辞，这是惯例。

en.t: As soon as he opened his eyes, he would insist on climbing up to the drying platform, no matter how much trouble it took; that was his custom.

units.source_text: 总而言之，非要闯入女佣的房间不可，不然就不能成眠。

en.t: In short, he had to force his way into the maid's room, or else he could not fall asleep.

units.source_text: 简直是不折不扣的闯入。

en.t: It was nothing less than an outright intrusion.

units.source_text: 这种肆无忌惮的行为，十年来一贯如此。

en.t: This brazen behavior had gone on unchanged for ten years.

units.source_text: 他每月照例来两次，近似献殷勤了。

en.t: He came twice every month as a matter of routine, almost as if paying court.
